name: DePauw University
academic_ranking: DePauw University is a highly regarded private liberal arts college in Greencastle, Indiana, consistently ranked among the top national liberal arts colleges (typically ranked in the top ~50-60 range by U.S. News). Known for strong programs in music (School of Music), sciences, and the humanities, and a robust liberal arts curriculum with high faculty engagement.
financial_aid: More than 95% of DePauw students receive some form of financial assistance. Beginning Fall 2026, DePauw meets 100% of calculated financial need for all incoming first-year students ('The DePauw Promise'). Merit scholarships range from $20,000 up to full tuition and are awarded automatically upon admission. As an NCAA Division III institution, athletic scholarships are not offered. Source: depauw.edu admission-aid page, checked 2026-07.
facilities_notes: Softball home venue is DePauw Tigers Field (softball). Source: depauwtigers.com softball roster/facilities navigation, checked 2026-07.
program_reputation: DePauw softball competes in the North Coast Athletic Conference (NCAA Division III). The Tigers are led by head coach Gabby Smart, a DePauw '17 alumna. The program carries a 22-player roster for the 2026 season.
notes: Data gathered live from depauwtigers.com softball coaches, roster, and staff directory pages plus depauw.edu admission-aid page, 2026-07. As an NCAA D3 program, no athletic scholarships are awarded. Exact annual tuition figure could not be confirmed from a live authoritative page during research (relevant depauw.edu cost pages returned 404); left as null rather than guessing. No public phone numbers or Twitter/X handles were listed for coaching staff.
